content.description: Block tree of the document content.

account.description: Account uid the document belongs to.

authors.description: Uids of every account that has modified the document, including the original author.

path.description: Path of the document within the account; empty string for the home document.

updateTime.description: Time the document was last updated.

metadata.description: The document's metadata, such as name, icon, and cover.

detachedBlocks.description: Blocks that were created but never moved into the content, keyed by block id.

genesis.description: CID of the document's genesis change.
CID of the genesis change the generation starts from.

generation.description: Opaque generation number; a higher generation supersedes earlier ones for the same genesis.

generationInfo.description: Generation of the document this content belongs to.

visibility.description: Visibility, `PUBLIC` or `PRIVATE`; unset or unspecified values read as `PUBLIC`.

description: A document as the API returns it: its metadata and content plus derived fields such as version, authors, and visibility.
